verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM platform, and self-hosting is a fair axis for CRMs. The evidence shows only a hosted SaaS offering (a free trial, a 'get started in minutes' signup, credit-based pricing) and never mentions a self-hosted, on-premise or open-source deployment option. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
